cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. I've approved curry in bread rolls: dinner and crockery in one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we manage twelve guests with six rolls?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Halves are approved. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread. An excellent improvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollowed halves are authorized. The crumbs can thicken the curry; now we've saved the flour as well as the plates. You may call this progress.

reason: Make each practical constraint produce a specific approved efficiency change, using the removed bread to address B runoff objection rather than adding an unrelated saving.
